crossRefs.note: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an…
For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call…
For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise…

translations.web: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
translations.bsb: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.
translations.kjv: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
translations.asv: but with him that standeth here with us this day before Jehovah our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day;
